classifications.rationale: The President states policy views and background criticism, but directs no agency action and creates no legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: My Administration is committed to protecting the American people from radical green agenda policies

classifications.rationale: The President immediately revokes a prior presidential memorandum, an internal administrative change expressly covered by Code 1.
classifications.evidence: I hereby revoke the Presidential Memorandum of September 27, 2023.

classifications.rationale: Within 15 days, the named department heads must pursue withdrawal from an interagency litigation MOU and rescind an environmental-review notice; these are administrative and procedural directions rather than dictated changes to legal rights.
classifications.evidence: The heads of departments shall also rescind the "Notice of Intent to Prepare a Supplemental Environmental Impact Statement (SEIS) for the Columbia River System Operations"

classifications.rationale: As appropriate, the department heads must schedule completion of an environmental review and reissue its notice under applicable procedures, which directs discretionary agency process without dictating a substantive legal result.
classifications.evidence: the heads of departments shall develop a schedule to complete the Supplemental Columbia River System Environmental Impact Statement

classifications.rationale: The department heads must submit the schedule to the CEQ Chair; this is internal reporting with no independent legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: The heads of departments shall submit the schedule to the Chair of the Council on Environmental Quality

classifications.rationale: The CEQ Chair must convene recurring interagency status meetings, an internal coordination function with no specified legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: shall convene regular meetings among the heads of departments

classifications.rationale: Within 30 days, the department heads must identify relevant actions, commitments, and possible future steps and report them to the President through the CEQ Chair; this is review and reporting rather than an order to impose a legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: the heads of departments shall identify and report to the President through the Chair of CEQ
